description: The attached Index List / Drawing List / component drawing must be the one shown on the assist letter or STC.
findingText: The attached Index List / Drawing List / component drawing is not the one identified on the assist letter or STC.
resolutionHint: Attach the drawing/index list named on the assist letter or STC, at the revision it cites.
limitations: Compares the recorded document number and revision; it does not inspect drawing content.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
